name: lead-quality-none-called
about: LQ3c: a young campaign whose leads nobody has called yet: no share of the called, no minutes to the first call, one lead that missed a hard requirement.

output.headline: 2 campaigns ran on November 3, 2026, spending $284.25 for 7 leads at $40.61 each across 14,600 impressions.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet led the day: $184.50 spent, 9,120 impressions, 141 clicks, 6 leads at $30.75 each, and a 1.5% click rate.
Dedicated night runs was quieter: $99.75 spent, 5,480 impressions, 62 clicks, 1 lead at $99.75, and a 1.1% click rate.
Month to date in November 2026, Meta has taken $612.30 of spend with 28 days still left in the month.

Lead quality for Regional Class A — Joliet over the last 14 days: 4 leads, none called yet so no median time to first call, and 1 missed a hard requirement — that is 25.0% of the campaign's leads, which is worth watching.

The 2026-09-28 cohort is mature: 40 leads, 50.0% converted, 30.0% applied, 12.5% hired, and 22.5% lost after conversion. The 2026-09-21 cohort shows similar shape: 38 leads, 44.7% converted, 26.3% applied, 10.5% hired.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads — 9 contacted, 3 converted, 1 applied — but it is too young to judge rates yet.
